query:
UPDATE cars SET 
mainImage = CASE 
  WHEN make = 'Tesla' AND model = 'Model 3 Long Range' THEN 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1560958089-b8a1929cea89?w=800'
  WHEN make = 'Audi' AND model = 'e-tron GT' THEN 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1614200187524-dc4b892acf16?w=800'
  WHEN make = 'BMW' AND model = 'iX xDrive50' THEN 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1617814076367-b759c7d7e738?w=800'
  WHEN make = 'Mercedes-Benz' AND model = 'EQS 450+' THEN 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1618843479313-40f8afb4b4d8?w=800'
  WHEN make = 'Porsche' AND model = 'Taycan 4S' THEN 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1614200187524-dc4b892acf16?w=800'
  WHEN make = 'Hyundai' AND model = 'IONIQ 5' THEN 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1617814076367-b759c7d7e738?w=800'
  WHEN make = 'Volkswagen' AND model = 'ID.4 Pro' THEN 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1560958089-b8a1929cea89?w=800'
  WHEN make = 'Polestar' AND model = '2 Long Range' THEN 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1614200187524-dc4b892acf16?w=800'
  WHEN make = 'Jaguar' AND model = 'I-PACE EV400' THEN 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1617814076367-b759c7d7e738?w=800'
  WHEN make = 'Kia' AND model = 'EV6 GT-Line' THEN 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1618843479313-40f8afb4b4d8?w=800'
END
WHERE isAuction = true;
